title: Course Schedule III
description:
There are n different online courses numbered from 1 to n . You are given an array courses where courses[i] = [duration i , lastDay i ] indicate that the i th course should be taken continuously for duration i days and must be finished before or on lastDay i . 
 
 You will start on the 1 st day and you cannot take two or more courses simultaneously. 
 
 Return the maximum number of courses that you can take . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 courses = [[100,200],[200,1300],[1000,1250],[2000,3200]]

Output:
 3
Explanation:

First, take the 1
st

th

st
 day.
Second, take the 3
rd
 course, it costs 1000 days so you will finish it on the 1100
th
 day, and ready to take the next course on the 1101
st
 day. 
Third, take the 2
nd
 course, it costs 200 days so you will finish it on the 1300
th
 day. 
The 4
th
 course cannot be taken now, since you will finish it on the 3300
th
 day, which exceeds the closed date.
```

 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 courses = [[1,2]]

Output:
 1
```

 Example 3: 
 
```
Input:
 courses = [[3,2],[4,3]]

Output:
 0
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= courses.length <= 10 4 
 
 1 <= duration i , lastDay i <= 10 4
